items.description:
The pilot in command of an Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi that encountered a sudden loss of altitude last week was on medication for "sleep difficulty", as per the airline's internal flight safety report accessed by NDTV.

The pilot, Sudeep Vashistha, who has tested positive for marijuana in a drug test twice, said that the "sleep did not come easily" to him during the layover.

global_silver_linings.title: Guard Becomes Celebrity Making Mini Statues For Each Event at Virginia Tech As Free Giveaways
global_silver_linings.snippet: The mini-statue of a warrior rhino was birthed in a guessing game. After graduating from Virginia Tech, Bryan Newton kept cultivating his school spirit and connections to campus by working for Rhino Sports and Entertainment Services. He provides security support for the company at Virginia Tech’s 1,274-seat performance hall.
global_silver_linings.reason: A security guard quietly turning his post into a creative tradition — crafting tiny handmade statues as free gifts for campus visitors — is a reminder that ordinary people can build real community through small, generous acts. It costs nothing but care, and that's exactly what makes it matter.

global_silver_linings.title: These Wetlands Treat the Wastewater of a Megacity
global_silver_linings.snippet: On a humid summer afternoon, Gagan Das mixes groundnut and mustard meal in water in a large drum. On either side of him, large ponds reflect the sun. Mango trees laden with fruit, palms heavy with their payload of yellow dates and shady neem trees line the embankments.
global_silver_linings.reason: Restoring wetlands to naturally filter a megacity's wastewater is a powerful example of working with nature rather than against it, cleaning water while simultaneously reviving habitat for wildlife. It's proof that ecological restoration and human need don't have to compete.
